`hold_ws_after_cts_by_corner` / `setup_ws_after_cts_by_corner` are worst slacks in ns (positive = met).

`source_latency_ns` is the clock insertion latency; the negative `target_latency_ns` is reported as given and not interpreted further.
`target_ns` = 1.3333 ns in cts_tool.json is the skew target (it equals 10% of the 13.333 ns period); the file does not label it further.
setup_ws_by_corner / hold_ws_by_corner in pnr_iterations.json are post-route worst slacks in ns (positive = met); the file does not label the stage explicitly.
